title: Create your first alert rule: condition

blocks.content:
Welcome to the alert rule condition learning path. You'll set the alert condition using the When input, choosing a collapse function and threshold that tells Grafana when to fire.

This path continues from the query learning path. Each learning path in this series covers one section of the alert rule form.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Choose a collapse function (reducer)
- Set a boundary value (threshold)
- Preview the condition to verify it evaluates correctly

## Before you begin

Before you start, ensure you have:

- Completed the query learning path (the rule form is already open with a query configured).

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.
